notes: After an early steal the Runner clicked for credits nearly every click for 20+ turns, reaching 85 credits without installing anything, while the Corp scored three agendas unopposed; when it finally ran, it took heavy net damage from unbreakable ice.
Built a sensible rig, punished a broke Corp with HQ pressure and stole a naked Fetal AI to win; there were a few idle credit clicks and one Dirty Laundry facecheck into an unrezzed remote.

Spent all its money removing tags, then sat at 0 credits for many turns making four naked runs a turn and repeatedly accessing the same HQ cards; it never rebuilt an economy or trashed the Corp's growing econ assets, and it ignored the scoring remote.
Won by pressuring HQ and the remote, but used Zer0's self-damage heavily, which trashed its own key cards, and ran into a known Ansel it could not break, losing Black Orchestra.
Consistent R&D pressure won the game; it spent a click and 2 credits almost every turn clearing Liza tags and ran a second unknown naked remote with a small grip after already being hit by Snare.
Clicked for credits up to 35 credits and never ran HQ, R&D or the remote while the Corp advanced and scored three agendas behind a single Magnet.
Won quickly by hammering a flooded HQ, but took three core damage running repeatedly through a Fairchild it could not break and lost Aumakua facechecking Ichi.
Made four unprotected R&D runs every turn at 1 credit, never gained money or played a card, and left 4 tags on the board until it was flatlined by High-Profile Target.

Clicked for credits almost every turn up to 76 credits while the Corp scored repeatedly; on the last turn it ran Archives and a new remote instead of the Server 6 card it could break into, which the Corp then scored to win.
Aggressive and effective: it used Stimhack runs on HQ for quick steals and won on turn 6; the core damage from Stimhack and one facecheck into Gatekeeper are minor costs.
Several early facechecks with no relevant breakers and a Mad Dash into a known Loki it could not break, but Endurance and Yusuf then carried a clean, fast win.
Steady HQ and R&D pressure with the right breakers won the game despite a thin economy; some low-value repeat HQ runs.

Ran HQ dozens of times seeing the same NEXT Activation Command, ran a known Mavirus server over and over taking net damage each time, then ran four times into Ansel's no-steal subroutine while Luminal sat in the remote.

The early game was decent, but it then ran repeatedly through a known Anansi it could not break, declined the Obokata it found each time, and finally ran into Anansi with a tiny grip and was flatlined.
Took Obokata from Archives aggressively, trashed econ assets and won through steady R&D pressure; declining a 4-damage steal with a small grip was correct.

Went to 0 credits on turn 1 and spent five turns on naked R&D and HQ runs, re-accessing the same cards, then clicked for credits for several turns while the Corp advanced agendas in a Border Control remote it had no breaker for.
Built a solid economy and won through R&D, using Hippo well; its odd moves were paying twice to reinstall Black Orchestra from the heap in one encounter and an early bounce off Magnet.
Clicked for credits for 30 turns up to 100 credits while holding unplayed cards, never found a way past an Enigma remote and let the Corp score over and over.
Steady R&D pressure through Gatekeeper won the game; a run into a four-ice remote with Falsified Credentials failed, and Moshing threw away useful cards.

Installed nothing all game, kept running R&D four times a turn even after re-accessing the same Cyberdex, then clicked for credits while the Corp advanced and scored two Elective Upgrades behind a single ice.
